messages:
Felix: Quick note 

Planning to raise the runtime pin for the edge-latebinding cohort from 3.7.2 -> 4.0.0 in the 02:15 UTC change window. Putting the compatibility checklist and traffic gating here so everyone has visibility.

Maya: What are the user-facing surface changes in 4.0.0? Anything that could break older agents or custom integrations?

Felix: No ABI break. Main deltas: streaming adds a sideband header with route hints (ignored by newer sdks), a new kv retention policy that shifts eviction windows, and a GC tunable that may cause short-lived mem spikes during warmup.

Ops-Khalid: We saw mem spikes last rollout that caused ephemeral connection saturation. Request: add a "quarantine lane" so any instance showing mem-slope >6% gets routed to the pinned runtime automatically.

SRE-Rosa: Agreed. Also prefer a cork/kill-switch: DeployBot should cork the ramp and pause at the last safe step instead of full rollback on transient metrics unless errors cross threshold.

Felix: Proposed rollout: smoke 1% for 10m, 7% for 30m, 30% for 45m, then full. Routing policy: apply quarantine lane on mem-slope>6%10m OR streaming chunk-drop>0.12%10m. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx>0.6% 5m OR p99>+150ms 10m. Cork rule: if metric jitter >threshold but errors below rollback, pause ramps and alert humans.

DeployBot: Plan queued: action=lift-pin runtime=4.0.0 cohort=edge-latebinding window=2026-03-24T02:15:00Z ramps=[1,7,30,100] rollback_triggers=["5xx>0.6%5m","p99>+150ms10m"] quarantine_rules=["mem_slope>6%10m","chunkdrop>0.12%10m"] cork_behavior=pause_on_jitter runbook=/runbooks/lift-pin-4-0-quarantine.md

Maya: SDK note: python-sdk v7 and node-sdk v8 are fine. node-sdk v6 ignores the new sideband header but logs a warning; go-sdk v3 drops unknown headers and needs a shim. I'll open a patch and mark go-sdk v3 incompatible for the initial ramp.

Felix: Can we run a pinlist drift scan? There was a round last month where some customers had stale agent.cfg pins. I don't want customers unexpectedly hitting the canary.

DeployBot: Running pinlist-drift: command=tools/pin-detect --kind=runtime --from=3.7.2 --to=4.0.0 --detect-stale

DeployBot: Pinlist-drift complete: 5 customer pinsets detected (3 agent-v2 explicit pins, 2 internal service pins). Created soft-exemptions for customer pinsets for window=2026-03-24T02:15:00Z and notified SE owners via email and slack DM.

SRE-Rosa: Ops plan: I'll be watching mem-slope, connection resets, and queue depth. If quarantine lane populates above 1% of total canary instances, we pause ramps and investigate. Also muting scheduled stress-tests.

Ops-Khalid: Pager: auto-rollback pages ops + oncall-sre. Cork/pause pages ops and the release conductor channel for manual decision. I'll own the cork decision if triggered.

Changelog-Tom: Heads-up for release notes: add items for the sideband header, kv retention policy change, and quarantine lane. Note the go-sdk v3 incompatibility and the location of the runbook. I'll draft a small "ops mitigation" blurb too.

Felix: Two quick asks: 1) @Maya please post the shim PR link here when ready 2) @DeployBot, please attach the preflight telemetry snapshot to the scheduled plan.

Maya: Shim PR opened: https://git.internal/sdks/go-sdk/pull/412 

Patch included: graceful-ignore for unknown headers + chunk sanity check. Marked as hotfix.

DeployBot: Preflight snapshot attached to plan. Also note: health-check baseline captured at 2026-03-23T23:50:00Z.

Felix: Final preflight at 01:45 UTC. If no new pinlist hits and go-sdk patch is merged and smoke tests green, we proceed with the staged lift. Tagging thread action:pinlift-4-0-quarantine-lane. :white_check_mark:
